runs_bat.text: Batting runs from our modified wRAA.

runs_br.text: Baserunning runs, includes SB and CS runs.

runs_dp.text: Runs from avoiding GIDPs in double-play-situation ground balls.

runs_field.text: Total fielding runs from TZR and DRS.

runs_position.text: Runs from the position they play (non-pitching).

runs_position_p.text: Adjustment to zero out the negative contribution of pitcher offense.

runs_replacement.text: The replacement level adjustment for the league.

runs_above_rep.text: The sum of the above components (double-counting excluded).

WAR.text: Wins above replacement, the final number.

WAR_off.text: Just offense, position and replacement level.

teamRpG.text: An average team's runs scored with this player.

oppRpG.text: An average team's runs allowed with this player.

oppRpPA_rep.text: An average team's runs allowed per PA by a replacement player.

oppRpG_rep.text: An average team's runs allowed per game by a replacement player.

pyth_exponent.text: Pythagenpat exponent based on run environment for average teams.

pyth_exponent_rep.text: Pythagenpat exponent based on a run environment for a replacement player.

waa_win_perc.text: The win percentage using the pyth_exponent and team and opponent R/G.

waa_win_perc_rep.text: How a replacement player would do.

xRA.text: Expected runs allowed based on offenses faced and interleague play.

xRA_sprp_adj.text: Adjustment based on whether innings were as a starter or reliever.

xRA_def_pitcher.text: Adjustment based on the quality of the pitcher's defense behind them.

xRA_extras_adj.text: The park-adjusted run expectancy of a runner on second with no outs, multiplied by the number of such innings they started.

PPF_custom.text: The park factor based on where they pitched.

BIP_perc.text: Percentage of the team's balls in play (used for defensive adjustment).

runs_above_avg_adj.text: Adjustment, so the runs_above_avg equal zero.

runs_above_rep.text: runs_above_avg multiplied by the league replacement level factor.

RpO_replacement.text: Runs per out for a replacement level pitcher.

teamRpG.text: The R/G for an average team in games this pitcher pitched.

oppRpG.text: An average opponent's R/G in games this pitcher pitched.

WAA_adj.text: Adjustment to make these sum to zero.

oppRpG_rep.text: The run scoring of an average team facing a replacement level pitcher.

pyth_exponent_rep.text: That Pythagenpat exponent (for the replacement level pitcher).

WAR_rep.text: The amount of WAR attributable to replacement level.
